subject: statistics: use new DDL event in stats handler (#48516)
summary: Refactors stats DDL-event plumbing to use a statistics-local DDLEvent type and a dedicated DDL handler. Checked the producer/consumer path end-to-end (DDL asyncNotifyEvent -> Handle.DDLEventCh -> Handle.FlushStats/HandleDDLEvent) and confirmed the handled action set and per-action behavior matches the prior implementation for stats KV initialization/reset and global-stats ID changes. No Blocker/High issues found in statistics correctness, concurrency, or compatibility within scope.
